purpose: The fine times of the letters of a known text in its speech (user 2026-11-05: cutting by letters in the script, in pure Rust), as a plug-in program. Version 2 (docs/102 step 5): the request carries the speech itself and names the model; the program finds the model in the AI catalog of the computer it runs on. Nothing falls back to another engine.
transport: The JSON lines of qnc.module.plugin-process: the application's hello, the plug-in's ready, then one request at a time.

align.body: { model, wav, words: [text] }: model is a model's name (its file or folder name); wav is a 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV as base64
align.ok: { words: [{ letters: [{ letter, start?, end? }] }] }: times in seconds from the start of wav; a sign the model has not (a comma) has no times

rules: The words are the text said in wav, in order. The plug-in reads no file of the application and writes nothing. A model not in its computer's AI catalog, or a text that cannot be laid on the speech, is an error, never a guess.
acceptance: crates/qnc-wav2vec2/examples/hear.rs (what the model hears) and tools/qnc-align-wav2vec2/examples/align_wav.rs (the letters of a known text in a WAV that is only read).
